title: Kirby's Motel 6 Burn, United Invades Dallas, and JetBlue Gives Away First Class
summary: United's CEO just compared rival airlines to a Four Seasons room bolted onto a Motel 6 — and he's backing it up by opening a crew base in American's backyard. Plus, JetBlue is handing out free first class seats like candy, British Airways quietly makes status worse, and a $135 million lounge offer somehow turns into a scandal in Seattle.
